text_en: An oracle concerning Egypt. See, the Lord is riding on a swift cloud and comes to Egypt; the idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence, and the heart of the Egyptians will melt within them.
text_cn: 有关埃及的神谕：看，上主乘着轻快的彩云，来到了埃及，埃及的偶像在他面前战栗，埃及人的心灵在己身内消溶。

text_en: I will stir up Egyptians against Egyptians, and they will fight, one against the other, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom;
text_cn: 我要激动埃及人相反埃及人，使人人与自己的兄弟相斗，人人与自己的近人作对，城与城争，国与国战。

text_en: the spirit of the Egyptians within them will be emptied out, and I will confound their plans; they will consult the idols and the spirits of the dead and the ghosts and the familiar spirits;
text_cn: 埃及的精神要纷乱，我要混乱她的计谋；为此他们必要去卜问神明、巫觋（xí）、阴魂和术士。

text_en: I will deliver the Egyptians into the hand of a hard master; a fierce king will rule over them, says the Sovereign, the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 我要把埃及交在暴君手中， 暴虐的君王要统治他们──这是主，万军上主的断语。

text_en: The waters of the Nile will be dried up, and the river will be parched and dry;
text_cn: 海洋的水将干涸，江河将荒凉干旱；

text_en: its canals will become foul, and the branches of Egypt’s Nile will diminish and dry up, reeds and rushes will rot away.
text_cn: 水道都将发臭，埃及的河渠都要转弱干涸；芦荻（dí）和菖(chāng)蒲必将萎谢；

text_en: There will be bare places by the Nile, on the brink of the Nile; and all that is sown by the Nile will dry up, be driven away, and be no more.
text_cn: 河畔的芦苇必将枯萎，沿河的植物，尽将凋零，吹散，消灭。

text_en: Those who fish will mourn; all who cast hooks in the Nile will lament, and those who spread nets on the water will languish.
text_cn: 渔夫必要呻吟叹息，河畔垂钓者必要悲伤，水面撒网者必要沮丧。

text_en: The workers in flax will be in despair, and the carders and those at the loom will grow pale.
text_cn: 种植亚麻者必要羞惭，理麻妇与纺织工也都要面色苍白。

text_en: Its weavers will be dismayed, and all who work for wages will be grieved.
text_cn: 她的显贵将受轻视，受雇的工人莫不意志消沉。

text_en: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish; the wise counselors of Pharaoh give stupid counsel. How can you say to Pharaoh, “I am one of the sages, a descendant of ancient kings”?
text_cn: 左罕的首领极其愚蠢， 法郎的谋士出的，尽是糊涂计谋；你们怎敢对法郎说：“我是贤者的子孙，古代帝王的后裔？”

text_en: Where now are your sages? Let them tell you and make known what the Lord of hosts has planned against Egypt.
text_cn: 你的贤士如今在那里？何不让他们告诉你知道，万军的上主对埃及打了什么主意！

text_en: The princes of Zoan have become fools, and the princes of Memphis are deluded; those who are the cornerstones of its tribes have led Egypt astray.
text_cn: 左罕的首领都够糊涂，诺夫的首领被人愚弄， 各州的诸侯使埃及陷入迷途。

text_en: The Lord has poured into them a spirit of confusion; and they have made Egypt stagger in all its doings as a drunkard staggers around in vomit.
text_cn: 上主在他们中间注入了昏神，叫他们使埃及在自己所作的事上无不错乱，有如醉汉在呕吐中打滚。

text_en: Neither head nor tail, palm branch or reed, will be able to do anything for Egypt.
text_cn: 不论是为首的、为尾的、为棕枝的、或为芦苇的作什么，为埃及无所作为。

text_en: On that day the Egyptians will be like women, and tremble with fear before the hand that the Lord of hosts raises against them.
text_cn: 到那天， 埃及面对着正在她身上挥动着的万军上主的手臂，将如妇女般的战栗害怕。

text_en: And the land of Judah will become a terror to the Egyptians; everyone to whom it is mentioned will fear because of the plan that the Lord of hosts is planning against them.
text_cn: 犹大地将成为埃及的恐怖；凡提及她的，无不对万军的上主对埃及所打的主意而害怕。

text_en: On that day there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the Lord of hosts. One of these will be called the City of the Sun.
text_cn: 到那天，在埃及境内将有五座城说客纳罕话，并指着万军的上主起誓，且有一座称作“太阳城”。

text_en: On that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the center of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the Lord at its border.
text_cn: 到那天，在埃及地域中，将有一座献与上主的祭坛，在她的边界上，将有一个为上主建立的石柱。

text_en: It will be a sign and a witness to the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt; when they cry to the Lord because of oppressors, he will send them a savior, and will defend and deliver them.
text_cn: 这在埃及境内，将成为万军上主的记号和证据：当他们面临迫害呼号上主时，他必给他们遣发一位救主，来奋斗拯救他们。

text_en: The Lord will make himself known to the Egyptians; and the Egyptians will know the Lord on that day, and will worship with sacrifice and burnt offering, and they will make vows to the Lord and perform them.
text_cn: 到那天，上主将为埃及所认识，埃及要认识上主，并奉献牺牲和祭品，向上主许愿还愿。

text_en: The Lord will strike Egypt, striking and healing; they will return to the Lord , and he will listen to their supplications and heal them.
text_cn: 上主将打击埃及，打击只是为医治；他们要归依上主，上主要俯听他们，要医治他们。

text_en: On that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian will come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
text_cn: 到那天，将有一条大路，由埃及通至亚述：亚述人要到埃及去，埃及人要到亚述来；埃及和亚述将共同敬拜上主。

text_en: On that day Israel will be the third with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth,
text_cn: 到那天，以色列将属第三，联同埃及和亚述成为大地上受祝福的，

text_en: whom the Lord of hosts has blessed, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my heritage. ”
text_cn: 因为万军的上主曾这样祝福说：“我的百姓埃及，我双手的工程亚述，我的嗣业以色列，是应受祝福的！”
